description: Update a Contract Payment. All attributes other than 'attachments', 'origin_id', and 'origin_data' will be locked if the contract payment is synced with an ERP system.

id.description: Unique identifier for this contract payment.

amount.description: Payment amount, returned as a decimal-formatted string.

legacy_amount_in_cents.description: Legacy representation of the payment amount in cents. Null for payments that do not carry a legacy amount; prefer the `amount` field.

bank_id.description: Identifier of the bank associated with the payment. Null when no bank is assigned.

check_number.description: Check number recorded for the payment, when paid by check.

contract_id.description: Contract ID associated with the payment

deleted_at.description: Timestamp when the payment was soft-deleted. Only present for deleted payments; absent otherwise.

invoice_date.description: Date of the invoice associated with this payment.

date_payment_funded.description: Timestamp when the payment was funded. Populated for payments processed through Procore Pay; null otherwise.

draw_request_number.description: Payment number of a Draw Request, Owner Invoice, or Subcontractor Invoice

external_payment_id.description: Only payments made through Procore Pay have an external_payment_id

payment_method.description: Method used to make the payment. Null when no method is recorded.

id.description: Unique identifier of the attached file.

url.description: Download URL for the attached file.

project_id.description: Integer ID for the associated Project

origin_id.description: Identifier for this payment in the external/third-party system it originated from.

origin_code.description: Code for this payment in the external/third-party system it originated from.

origin_data.description: Additional third-party data captured with this payment.

status.description: Current lifecycle status of the payment (for example, unpaid, in_review, approved, processing, paid, rejected, failed).

attachments.description:
Contract payment attachments.
To upload attachments you must upload the entire payload as `multipart/form-data` content-type and
specify each parameter as form-data together with `attachments[]` as...

prostore_file_ids.description: Any prostore files to actualize contract payment's attachments. Mutually exclusive with the `attachments` property.
